task_completion.description: Open the 'MRI Stack' sample image in ImageJ/Fiji.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window titled 'mri-stack.tif' or 'MRI Stack' showing a grayscale brain scan with a slider at the bottom indicating multiple slices (1/27).

task_completion.description: Generate the five required Z-projections: Max, Average, Min, Sum, and Standard Deviation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Multiple image windows or a sequence of operations in the 'Z Project' dialog showing the selection of 'Max Intensity', 'Average Intensity', 'Min Intensity', 'Sum Slices', and 'Standard Deviation'.

task_completion.description: Measure Mean, StdDev, Min, and Max for each of the five projections.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Results' table window in ImageJ populated with at least 5 rows of data, containing columns for Mean, StdDev, Min, and Max.
A file explorer window or a 'Save As' dialog showing the path '~/ImageJ_Data/results/zprojection_comparison.csv' being targeted or confirmed.

task_completion.description: Save the 'Standard Deviation' projection image as a TIFF file to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Standard Deviation' image window active followed by a 'Save As' dialog targeting '~/ImageJ_Data/results/stddev_projection.tif'.

integrity.description: The agent used the ImageJ GUI menus rather than just writing a script or using terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Image > Stacks > Z Project' menu path or the Z-Projection dialog box.

integrity.description: The agent actually performed the 'Measure' command on the projection images.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Results' window appearing and updating after each projection is generated, rather than a pre-written CSV being moved.

integrity.description: The agent is working with the correct MRI Stack dimensions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The image info bar at the top of the MRI Stack window should show dimensions of 186x226 and 27 slices.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'MRI Stack' sample image has a width of 186 pixels, a height of 226 pixels, and contains 27 slices. The Z-projection tool is found under 'Image > Stacks > Z Project'. The CSV must contain exactly 5 rows of data corresponding to the 5 projection types (Max, Average, Min, Sum, StdDev) with the four requested statistical columns.
